content.text:
The bug is fixed: an unclosed `[` or `![` no longer turns a later code span into literal text. The markdown-it suite (299 tests), the CommonMark spec suite and lint all pass; I did not run the build, type-check or `test:build` steps.

**Cause:** the backtick rule in `src/rules_inline/backticks.ts` keeps a cache of the last position of each backtick-run length, but it only recorded runs whose length differed from the opener. The link/image rule first scans the label in validation mode, which matches `` `bar` `` and then fails on the trailing lone backtick, marking the line as fully scanned. When the real pass reached `` `bar` `` again, the cache had no entry for its closer, so the rule concluded there was none and emitted the backtick as text.

**Fix:** the scan now records every backtick run it sees, including matched closers, keeping the furthest position per length.

I added four regression cases to `test/fixtures/markdown-it/commonmark_extras.txt`: the three inputs from the report plus one mixing run lengths.
